start.speaker: Serjeant Halbrek
start.text: Who is that? Step into the light — there is no light. Habit. I am the serjeant of this gate and the gate is behind me and I have not been up in a long while. Are you going up? I can walk. I have been telling myself that for a while now.

choices.text: I am going down, not up.

taken.speaker: Serjeant Halbrek
taken.text: Then I will keep up, and if I do not keep up you will not stop. Say it. — Good. That is the arrangement everybody else lied about.

left.speaker: Serjeant Halbrek
left.text: Then go. I will keep this landing warm until you come back for me. That is not a joke, though it nearly was.

committed.speaker: Serjeant Halbrek
committed.text: I am behind you while this run lasts. Get us to the ascent and I will find the tower on my own feet.

already.speaker: An empty landing
already.text: Somebody sat here long enough to wear the stone smooth. Whoever it was is not sitting here now.
